text.lead: Marriage Story (Korean: 결혼 이야기) is a 1992 South Korean romantic comedy film directed by Kim Ui-seok and starring Choi Min-soo and Shim Hye-jin. It was the highest-grossing South Korean film of 1992, and became the fourth most highly attended Korean film between 1990 and 1995.
text.plot: The film follows the romantic relationship between middle-class couple Kim Tae-kyu and Choe Ji-hae, from their wedding to a break-up and eventual reconciliation.
text.cast:
- Choi Min-soo as Kim Tae-kyu
- Shim Hye-jin as Choe Ji-hae
- Lee Hee-do as Yun Il-jung
- Kim Hui-ryeong as Oh Hyang-suk
- Kim Seong-su as PD Han
- Dokgo Young-jae as Park Chang-su
- Yang Taek-jo as Cha-jang
- Joo Ho-sung as Shin Seon-bae
- Yun Mun-sik as Jjik-sae
- Kim Ki-hyeon as Columbo
